name: Alice
source:
[url=/c83806]Arnaud[/url]'s mother and [url=/c88384]Daniel[/url]'s wife.
She was raised as the daughter of a rich family and has a reserved personality.
She's still as charming as a young girl.
She trusts her husband and devotedly supports him.
